title: Single Number (XOR Cancellation)

monster.name: XOR Goblin
monster.title: Canceler of Identical Pairs
monster.defeatQuote: Every paired number cancels to zero, leaving the solitary integer!

description: Given a non-empty array of integers `nums`, every element appears twice except for one. Find that single one. You must implement a solution with a linear runtime complexity and use only constant extra space.
hints: XOR of any number with itself is 0 (a ^ a = 0). XOR of any number with 0 is itself (a ^ 0 = a).
